mapper.select: select mn.*, sc.c_name AS unitName, pp.p_name AS pName, cc.con_name AS conName, sp.post_name AS postName, rl.level_name AS levelName FROM safe_responsibility_post_person mn LEFT JOIN pre_project pp ON mn.p_id = pp.p_id LEFT JOIN Con_Contract cc ON mn.con_id = cc.con_id LEFT JOIN Sys_company sc ON mn.unit_id = sc.c_id LEFT JOIN safe_responsibility_post sp ON mn.post_id = sp.id LEFT JOIN safe_responsibility_level rl ON sp.level_id = rl.id where mn.id = #{id}
